question: On which day is Gudi Padwa celebrated in the month of Chaitra as per the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**First**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gudi Padwa,** which is mostly observed in the state of **Maharashtra, ushers in the harvest season.**
 
• According to the** lunisolar Hindu calendar,** Maharashtrians celebrate the day as New Year's Day.
